intro.title: Star Rating Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you'll build an interactive star rating component that allows users to select and display ratings. You'll learn how to manage component state in React using the useState hook to track the current rating. The component will use TypeScript to define proper types for props and state, ensuring type safety. You'll implement click handlers to update the rating when users click on stars, and conditionally render filled or empty stars based on the current rating value.
intro.usecase: Star rating components are essential interactive UI elements found across modern web applications. You'll implement them in e-commerce product pages for customer reviews, in streaming platforms for content ratings, and in feedback forms for user surveys. As a developer, you'll build these components to capture user sentiment, display aggregated ratings, and enhance user engagement with intuitive visual feedback. Mastering this pattern prepares you for common frontend tasks like handling user input, managing component state, and creating reusable UI controls.
